title: 8 Best Bill.com Alternatives in 2026
summary: Compare the 8 best Bill.com alternatives in 2026, led by AI agents like Concourse alongside Tipalti, Stampli, and Ramp, by fit, automation depth, and cost.
body_markdown:
Bill.com (now BILL) is one of the most widely used AP and AR platforms for small and mid-sized businesses, and for simple payables with payments built in it is hard to beat. But its per-transaction fees, SMB orientation, and payments-first model send plenty of teams looking for **Bill.com alternatives** , whether to cut cost, scale up, or take a different approach to the AP workflow.


This guide compares the eight best Bill.com alternatives in 2026. The biggest shift is the arrival of AI agents, led by Concourse, that *run* the AP and AR workflow rather than bundling it with a payment network, alongside AP platforms like Tipalti, Stampli, and Ramp. For the full field, see our guide to the[best accounts payable software](https://www.concourse.ai/insights/best-accounts-payable-software) .


## **What are the best Bill.com alternatives?**


> Concourse is the top Bill.com alternative in 2026 for teams that want AI agents to run the AP and AR workflow, invoice capture and coding, matching, approvals, and collections, across their existing systems with every number traceable to source. The other strong alternatives fit specific needs: Tipalti for global payables, Stampli for invoice-centric AP, Melio for simple SMB bill pay, Ramp for spend plus bill pay, AvidXchange for the middle market, Vic.ai for autonomous invoice processing, and SAP Concur for enterprise expense and invoice.


> **Concourse is the AI-agent alternative on this list.** Instead of a payments-first platform, Concourse deploys finance agents that connect to your ERP, data warehouse, and billing data and run the AP and AR workflow across them: capturing and coding invoices, matching, routing approvals, and chasing receivables, with a human approving and every output traceable to source.


## **Why teams look for Bill.com alternatives**


Bill.com earns its place with small businesses. The friction shows up as teams grow or look closely at the cost.


**Per-transaction fees add up.** On top of the per-user subscription, BILL charges fees on every payment. For teams with meaningful payment volume, those fees often exceed the seat cost. See our[Bill.com pricing](https://www.concourse.ai/insights/bill-com-pricing) breakdown.


**It is built for SMB.** Bill.com is oriented to smaller businesses, so the largest or most complex payables operations, especially global ones, can outgrow it.


**It is payments-first.** Bill.com bundles the AP and AR workflow with its payment network. Teams whose real need is the invoice workflow, or who want to keep their own payment rail, often want a different model.


## **How we evaluated Bill.com alternatives**


- **Automation depth.** Whether it executes the invoice and collections workflow or mainly tracks it.
- **Payments.** Domestic and cross-border payment coverage, and whether payments are bundled or separate.
- **AI capability.** From rules-based OCR to autonomous processing and agents.
- **Fit.** Ideal company size, from SMB to global enterprise.
- **Cost model.** Subscription plus transaction fees versus scoped pricing.

## **The 8 best Bill.com alternatives in 2026**


### **1. Concourse, Best for AI Agents That Run AP and AR**


Concourse is an AI agent platform for corporate finance, and the strongest Bill.com alternative for teams that want the workflow run rather than bundled with payments. It connects to your ERP, data warehouse, and billing data and runs the AP and AR workflow across them: capturing and coding invoices, matching them to purchase orders and receipts, routing approvals, and chasing receivables, with a human approving at each gate.


The difference from Bill.com is the model and the footprint. Concourse does not bundle a payment network or charge per-transaction fees; its agents work across the tools you already run, and every output traces back to source and is validated against evals built for your business. It meets teams inside ChatGPT, Claude, Slack, Teams, and email, exports to Excel and PowerPoint, reports customer results including a 75% reduction in manual work and 20+ hours saved per user per month, is SOC 2 Type II certified, and connects to 100+ systems including NetSuite, QuickBooks, Snowflake, Salesforce, and Stripe.


**Best for.** Finance teams that want AI agents to run the AP and AR workflow across their existing stack, with full traceability and no per-transaction fees.


**Keep in mind.** Concourse is an agent layer, not a payment network. For executing supplier payments, run it alongside your own payment rail.


### **2. Tipalti, Best for Global AP and Mass Payments**


Tipalti automates end-to-end global accounts payable and mass supplier payments, including tax and compliance and cross-border payouts, a step up for teams that outgrow Bill.com's SMB scope. Founded in 2010, it says it[processes over $100 billion in payments annually](https://tipalti.com/company/) .


**Best for.** Mid-market and high-growth companies paying many suppliers across borders.


**Keep in mind.** It is priced for mid-market and up, with transaction and FX costs. See[Tipalti pricing](https://www.concourse.ai/insights/tipalti-pricing) .


### **3. Stampli, Best for Invoice-Centric AP**


Stampli is AI-driven AP automation built around the invoice, centering capture, coding, and collaboration on each invoice, and it deploys on an existing ERP without re-engineering the process. It[raised a $61M Series D led by Blackstone in 2023](https://www.fintechfutures.com/fintech-start-ups/ap-automation-start-up-stampli-raises-61m-in-blackstone-led-series-d) .


**Best for.** Mid-market teams that want invoice-centric AP that deploys fast.


**Keep in mind.** It focuses on the invoice workflow rather than being a full AR and payments platform.


### **4. Melio, Best for Simple SMB Bill Pay**


Melio is the closest SMB peer to Bill.com, a straightforward AP and bill-pay platform letting small businesses pay vendors by ACH, card, or check with accounting integrations. In 2025,[Xero agreed to acquire Melio for roughly $2.5 billion](https://www.pymnts.com/acquisitions/2025/xero-acquires-b2b-bill-pay-platform-melio-for-2-5-billion/) .


**Best for.** US-based small businesses that want simple vendor bill pay.


**Keep in mind.** Its scope is narrow SMB bill pay, and it is being absorbed into Xero, so weigh the roadmap.


### **5. Ramp, Best for Spend Plus Bill Pay**


Ramp pairs corporate cards and spend management with AP and bill pay, adding AI-assisted invoice processing to its card-and-expense core. Founded in 2019, it reached a[$32 billion valuation in November 2025](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2025-11-17/ramp-hits-32-billion-valuation-in-lightspeed-led-funding) .


**Best for.** Startups through mid-market that want cards, expense, and bill pay in one platform.


**Keep in mind.** AP is a module on a card-and-expense core, so it is less of a dedicated AR or global-AP tool.


### **6. AvidXchange, Best for the Middle Market**


AvidXchange is AP automation and B2B payments purpose-built for the middle market and their suppliers. It reported[full-year 2024 revenue of $438.9 million](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1858257/000095017025027324/avdx-ex99_1.htm) and was taken private by TPG and Corpay in October 2025.


**Best for.** Middle-market companies in real estate, construction, HOA, and healthcare.


**Keep in mind.** It is strongest in specific verticals and is US-focused.


### **7. Vic.ai, Best for Autonomous Invoice Processing**


Vic.ai is an AI-first tool for autonomous, touchless invoice processing, learning to capture, code, and approve invoices with minimal human touch. Founded in 2017, it[raised a $52M Series C in 2022](https://www.fintechfutures.com/accounting-payroll/accounting-automation-platform-vic-ai-bags-52m-series-c-funding) .


**Best for.** Larger teams and firms with high invoice volumes that want the highest degree of automation.


**Keep in mind.** It focuses on invoice processing, not a full AP and AR payments suite.


### **8. SAP Concur, Best for Expense and Invoice**


SAP Concur combines invoice and AP management with travel and expense, tightly integrated with SAP and other ERPs. SAP[acquired Concur in 2014 for roughly $8 billion](https://techcrunch.com/2014/09/18/sap-to-acquire-expense-software-maker-concur-for-129-per-share/) .


**Best for.** Large enterprises, especially SAP shops that want expense and invoice together.


**Keep in mind.** It is often described as powerful but heavy and expensive, and is an enterprise step up from Bill.com's SMB focus.


*Also worth a look:* Airbase and Brex (spend plus AP), and Esker (source-to-pay automation).


## **Which Bill.com alternative is right for you?**


- **Choose Concourse** if you want AI agents to *run* the AP and AR workflow across the systems you already have, with every number traceable and no per-transaction fees.
- **Choose Tipalti** if you are scaling into global, cross-border payables.
- **Choose Stampli** if you want invoice-centric AP that deploys fast.
- **Choose Melio** if you want simple SMB bill pay like Bill.com but different.
- **Choose Ramp** if you want spend, cards, and bill pay together.
- **Choose AvidXchange** if you are a middle-market company in its core verticals.
- **Choose Vic.ai** if you want autonomous, touchless invoice processing.
- **Choose SAP Concur** if you are an enterprise that wants expense and invoice together.


## **Frequently asked questions**


### **What is the best alternative to Bill.com?**


For teams that want AI agents to run the AP and AR workflow across their existing systems without per-transaction fees, Concourse is the strongest Bill.com alternative in 2026. Beyond that it depends on your need: Tipalti for global payables, Stampli for invoice-centric AP, and Melio for simple SMB bill pay.


### **Is there a cheaper alternative to Bill.com?**


It depends on your payment volume, since Bill.com's per-transaction fees are often the larger cost. AI-agent tools like Concourse run the workflow with scoped pricing and no per-transaction fees, while Melio is a comparable SMB bill-pay option. Model total cost by payment volume, not just seats.


### **What is the best Bill.com alternative for growing companies?**


Companies outgrowing Bill.com's SMB scope often look at Tipalti for global payables or Stampli for invoice-centric AP, and increasingly at AI-agent platforms like Concourse to run the AP and AR workflow across their existing systems without scaling transaction fees.


### **How is an AI agent different from Bill.com?**


Bill.com bundles the AP and AR workflow with a payment network and charges per-transaction fees. AI agents like Concourse instead run the invoice and collections workflow, capturing, coding, matching, routing, and chasing, across your existing systems, while you keep your own payment rail. Many teams pair a payment rail with an agent layer.


## **The bottom line**


Bill.com is a strong SMB AP and AR platform, but it is not the right fit for every team. If its per-transaction fees, SMB scope, or payments-first model is pushing you to look elsewhere, the strongest 2026 alternative for teams that want AI agents to run the workflow is Concourse. Among the specialists, Tipalti leads global payables, Stampli leads invoice-centric AP, and Melio leads simple SMB bill pay.
